question: The first edition of the Khelo India University Games was hosted in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2020**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The first edition of the Khelo India University Games was held in 2020.
 
• The event took place in Bhubaneswar, the capital city of Odisha.
 
• The Khelo India University Games is part of the Khelo India initiative, which aims to promote sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• The Games saw participation from various universities across India, making it a significant step towards nurturing young sports talent in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Programme**

 
 
• The Khelo India programme was introduced by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in 2018.
 
• It aims to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level by building a strong framework for all sports played in the country and establishing India as a great sporting nation.
 
• The programme includes initiatives for talent identification, sports infrastructure development, and support for athletes.
 
• It comprises various components such as Khelo India School Games, Khelo India Youth Games, Khelo India University Games, and Khelo India Winter Games.
 
 
 
• **Importance of University Games**
 
 
• University Games provide a platform for young athletes to showcase their talent and gain competitive experience.
 
• They help in identifying and nurturing sports talent at the university level.
 
• These games promote the importance of physical fitness and sports among the youth.
 
• Participation in such events can lead to greater opportunities for athletes, including scholarships and professional training.
 
 
 
• **Sports Infrastructure Development**
 
 
• The development of sports infrastructure is a crucial aspect of the Khelo India initiative.
 
• It includes the construction and upgradation of sports facilities across the country.
 
• The aim is to provide athletes with state-of-the-art facilities to train and compete.
 
• This also includes the establishment of sports academies and centers of excellence.
